title: Delving into Identify-Emphasize Paradigm for Combating Unknown Bias
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical debiasing within the field of computer vision, specifically addressing how models learn 'shortcut' features in image classification. While it discusses fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equality of Odds) and social attributes like gender in the context of the Biased CelebA dataset, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethical systems.
